title: Asamiya Sahityar Buranji Vol 1
author: Bisweswar Hazarika & ABILAC
description: Monumental first volume of the comprehensive history of Assamese literature published by the Anandaram Borooah Institute of Language, Art and Culture (ABILAC), covering the pre-historic to medieval era with in-depth analysis of Tai Buranjis, folk ballads, and ethnic linguistic substrates.
